name: codetrack-companion
description: CodeTrack desktop quickball for professors and students
author: CodeTrack

scripts.dev: node scripts/set-role.cjs unlocked && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && electron ."
scripts.dev:student: node scripts/set-role.cjs student && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && electron ."
scripts.dev:professor: node scripts/set-role.cjs professor && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && electron ."
scripts.dist:unlocked: node scripts/set-role.cjs unlocked && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:student: node scripts/set-role.cjs student && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.student.cjs
scripts.dist:professor: node scripts/set-role.cjs professor && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.professor.cjs
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:student && npm run dist:professor
scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/set-role.cjs unlocked && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir
